newsitem.title: USA: Polysindo buying 3 mln Dyersburg shares.
newsitem.headline: Polysindo buying 3 mln Dyersburg shares.

text.p: Polysindo Hong Kong Ltd, an affiliate of P.T. Texmaco Jaya, has entered into an agreement to acquire three million shares of Dyersburg Corp, or about a 23 percent stake, Dyersburg said Wednesday.
The shares are being sold by a group of individual and corporate shareholders in a private transaction, Dyersburg said.
The stock will be purchased for cash at an average price of $7.65 per share, Dyersburg said.
The selling shareholders are part of the group of investors that acquired Dyersburg Fabrics in 1986, Dyersburg said.
Dyersburg, which will receive none of the proceeds from the stock sale, said it currently has about 13.1 million shares outstanding.
The transaction, which is subject to a regulatory waiting period, is expected to close by April 30.
Texmaco Jaya is a subsidiary of Polysindo Eka Perkasa, Indonesia's biggest textile group.
